Meet the owner

About David

Because David started out cleaning and repairing window treatments, we also offer blind and shade repair and cleaning for the treatments you already have.

My name is David Fear, owner of Beautiful Blinds & Shades of Fort Wayne, Indiana. If you had asked me 20 years ago where my career would lead, I never would’ve guessed it would involve custom window treatments and drapery, but here I am!

I spent my first five years in the industry cleaning and repairing window treatments, and the last five years building a career I’m proud of in sales and installation. I’ve found my place, and I’m here for the long haul.

I see my main role as an educator, helping clients navigate the many options, styles, and price points in the world of window coverings. When I’ve done my job right, it’s incredibly rewarding to see that final install come together and watch a client smile as they enjoy the beauty and functionality of their home.

Working with David

What to expect

One window or a whole home, the visit works the same way. We serve Fort Wayne and nearby communities.

More about our window treatment service

  1. Compare samples at home

    David brings samples so you can see colors and materials in your own light. Talk through privacy, glare, controls, and your budget.

  2. Measure and review your quote

    David measures your windows and checks the mounting details. You review the products and the quote before anything is ordered.

  3. Installation and help afterward

    David installs your treatments, checks how they work, and shows you how to use them. If something needs attention later, give us a call.
